name: What measures can I take to prevent future sewer backups?

mainEntity.name: What measures can I take to prevent future sewer backups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future sewer backups often involves a combination of mindful habits and regular maintenance. Avoid flushing non-biodegradable items like wet wipes, paper towels, or feminine hygiene products. Be cautious about pouring grease down drains, as it can solidify and cause blockages. Consider having your sewer lines inspected periodically, especially if your home is older or you have mature trees nearby whose roots can invade pipes. Installing a backwater valve can also offer protection against municipal sewer line issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent backups by avoiding flushing non-biodegradables and grease. Consider periodic sewer line inspections and installing a backwater valve.
